name: Admin Question Studio & Bank Management
description: Verifies opening the Admin Question Studio modal, filtering database questions, and bulk import tool interface.

planSteps.description: Navigate to Assessments tab and click 'Admin Question Studio' button
Assert that the Admin Question Studio modal opens and displays the question bank table
Click 'Bulk Import' tab inside the admin modal
Click 'Load Sample Questions Template' to populate the JSON editor
Assert that the JSON textarea contains valid sample questions structure
Close the Admin Question Studio modal
